### Before you paste anything

- Replace host names with `host-01`, `host-02`, ...
- Replace serials with `SYN0001` and WWPNs with `10000090FA0000NN`.
- Remove IP addresses, user names and mount paths that name a client or application.
- Never post output from a client system without their written permission.
